meta.title: Ask-every clarification protocol
meta.description: Three-stage gate plus an engine-level hard gate: (1) restating and clarifying the need through an ask_user_question popup, (2) presenting a numbered plan-direction checklist selected via popup, and (3) a fixed final gate question — does this satisfy your need, may I execute — before any work starts. The hard gate (on by default) is a tool guard that denies every non-allowlisted tool call until the user clicks go; sessions stay locked across restarts. Tunable via the ask-every row config, including hardGate: false for prompt-only mode.
